ideas.pitch: An AI-powered real-time tactical assistant that listens to team comms during a match and suggests optimal utility setups and rotation timings.
ideas.title: Valorant Tactical Coach Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates heavy technical execution in live voice processing under tight hackathon timeframes, directly appealing to competitive esports judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated reinforcement learning bot capable of simulating basic tactical engagements on custom Valorant map layouts for pre-match strat crafting.
ideas.title: ZoneBot Autonomous Match Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on complex agent architectures proven in previous hackathon wins, offering a jaw-dropping live demonstration.

ideas.pitch: A unified platform for the Valorant tournament featuring automated real-time standings updates and dynamic viewer engagement feeds.
ideas.title: Esports Tournament Bracket & Live Telemetry Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate logistical need for the event organizers, ensuring high utility and direct appreciation from event hosts.

ideas.pitch: An automated clipping tool that ingests match VODs or live capture feeds, detecting multi-kills and clutch moments to generate social-ready highlight reels instantly.
ideas.title: Valorant Highlight Reel Automator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate, highly shareable visual content that tournament organizers and participants can use right away after the event.

ideas.pitch: A live micro-prediction web app where attendees can wager virtual points on match outcomes and individual round clutches during the tournament.
ideas.title: ClutchRate Gamified Betting & Prediction App
ideas.why_it_could_win: Gamification of live spectator sports creates high engagement among waiting teams and peers in the venue.
